title: ModelDriveFile
description: Canonical JSON contract for a drive file resource in jocaagura_domain.

id.description: Unique identifier of the file resource.

mimeType.description: Interoperable MIME type of the file content.

parentId.description: Identifier of the parent folder. Null represents a file located at the root of the logical tree.

path.description: Canonical absolute path of the file in the logical drive tree.

webUrl.description: Optional web URL that opens the file.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO-8601 date-time format.

trashed.description: Whether the file is currently marked as trashed.

meta.description: Optional open metadata bag for provider-specific or indexing details.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

extension.description: Optional file extension without changing the canonical file name.
